text_en: On one occasion when Jesus was going to the house of a leader of the Pharisees to eat a meal on the sabbath, they were watching him closely.
text_cn: 安息日，耶稣进了一个法利塞人首领的家中吃饭；他们就留心观察他。

text_en: Just then, in front of him, there was a man who had dropsy.
text_cn: 在他面前有一个患水臌(gǔ)症的人。

text_en: And Jesus asked the lawyers and Pharisees, “Is it lawful to cure people on the sabbath, or not? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对法学士及法利塞人说道：“安息日许不许治病？”

text_en: But they were silent. So Jesus took him and healed him, and sent him away.
text_cn: 他们都默然不语。耶稣遂扶着那人，治好他，叫他走了。

text_en: Then he said to them, “If one of you has a child or an ox that has fallen into a well, will you not immediately pull it out on a sabbath day? ”
text_cn: 然后向他们说：“你们中间，谁的儿子或牛掉在井里，在安息日这一天，不立刻拉他上来呢？”

text_en: And they could not reply to this.
text_cn: 他们对这话不能答辩。

text_en: When he noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, he told them a parable.
text_cn: 耶稣注意到被邀请的人，如何争选首席，便对他们讲了一个比喻说：

text_en: “When you are invited by someone to a wedding banquet, do not sit down at the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited by your host;
text_cn: “几时你被人请去赴婚筵，不要坐在首席上，怕有比你更尊贵的客人也被他请来，

text_en: and the host who invited both of you may come and say to you, ‘Give this person your place, ’ and then in disgrace you would start to take the lowest place.
text_cn: 那请你而又请他的人要来向你说：请让座给这个人！那时，你就要含羞地去坐末席了。

text_en: But when you are invited, go and sit down at the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he may say to you, ‘Friend, move up higher’; then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
text_cn: 你几时被请，应去坐末席，等那请你的人走来给你说：朋友，请上坐罢！那时，在你同席的众人面前，你才有光彩。

text_en: For all who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted. ”
text_cn: 因为凡高举自己的，必被贬抑；凡贬抑自己的，必被高举。”

text_en: He said also to the one who had invited him, “When you give a luncheon or a dinner, do not invite your friends or your brothers or your relatives or rich neighbors, in case they may invite you in return, and you would be repaid.
text_cn: 耶稣也向请他的人说：“几时你设午宴或晚宴，不要请你的朋友、兄弟、亲戚及富有的邻人，怕他们也要回请而还报你。

text_en: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind.
text_cn: 但你几时设筵，要请贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的人。

text_en: And you will be blessed, because they cannot repay you, for you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous. ”
text_cn: 如此，你有福了，因为他们没有可报答你的；但在义人复活的时候，你必能得到赏报。”

text_en: One of the dinner guests, on hearing this, said to him, “Blessed is anyone who will eat bread in the kingdom of God! ”
text_cn: 有一个同席的人听了这些话，就向耶稣说：“将来能在天主的国里吃饭的，才是有福的！”

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “Someone gave a great dinner and invited many.
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“有一个人设了盛宴，邀请了许多人。

text_en: At the time for the dinner he sent his slave to say to those who had been invited, ‘Come; for everything is ready now. ’
text_cn: 到了宴会的时刻，他便打发仆人去给被请的人说：请来罢！已经齐备了。

text_en: But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said to him, ‘I have bought a piece of land, and I must go out and see it; please accept my regrets. ’
text_cn: 众人开始一致推辞。第一个给他说：我买了一块田地，必须前去看一看，请你原谅我。

text_en: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out; please accept my regrets. ’
text_cn: 另一个说：我买了五对牛，要去试试它们，请你原谅我。

text_en: Another said, ‘I have just been married, and therefore I cannot come. ’
text_cn: 别的一个说：我才娶了妻，所以不能去。

text_en: So the slave returned and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his slave, ‘Go out at once into the streets and lanes of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame. ’
text_cn: 仆人回来把这事告诉了主人。家主就生了气，给仆人说：你快出去，到城中的大街小巷，把那些贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的，都领到这里来。

text_en: And the slave said, ‘Sir, what you ordered has been done, and there is still room. ’
text_cn: 仆人说：主，已经照你的吩咐办了，可是还有空位子。

text_en: Then the master said to the slave, ‘Go out into the roads and lanes, and compel people to come in, so that my house may be filled.
text_cn: 主人对仆人说：你出去，到大道上以及篱笆边，勉强人进来，好坐满我的屋子。

text_en: For I tell you, none of those who were invited will taste my dinner. ’”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：先前被请的那些人，没有一个能尝我这宴席的。”

text_en: Now large crowds were traveling with him; and he turned and said to them,
text_cn: 有许多群众与耶稣同行，耶稣转身向他们说：

text_en: “Whoever comes to me and does not hate father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters, yes, and even life itself, cannot be my disciple.
text_cn: “如果谁来就我，而不恼恨自己的父亲、母亲、妻子、儿女、兄弟、姊妹，甚至自己的性命，不能做我的门徒。

text_en: Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.
text_cn: 不论谁，若不背着自己的十字架，在我后面走，不能做我的门徒。

text_en: For which of you, intending to build a tower, does not first sit down and estimate the cost, to see whether he has enough to complete it?
text_cn: 你们中间谁愿意建造一座塔，而不先坐下筹算费用，是否有力完成呢？

text_en: Otherwise, when he has laid a foundation and is not able to finish, all who see it will begin to ridicule him,
text_cn: 免得他奠基以后，竟不能完工，所有看见的人都要讥诮(qiào)他，

text_en: saying, ‘This fellow began to build and was not able to finish. ’
text_cn: 说：这个人开始建造，而不能完工。

text_en: Or what king, going out to wage war against another king, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to oppose the one who comes against him with twenty thousand?
text_cn: 或者一个国王要去同别的国王交战，那有不先坐下运筹一下，能否以一万人，去抵抗那领着两万来攻打他的呢？

text_en: If he cannot, then, while the other is still far away, he sends a delegation and asks for the terms of peace.
text_cn: 如果不能，就得趁那国王离得尚远的时候，派遣使节去求和平的条款。

text_en: So therefore, none of you can become my disciple if you do not give up all your possessions.
text_cn: 同样，你们中不论是谁，如不舍弃他的一切所有，不能做我的门徒。

text_en: “Salt is good; but if salt has lost its taste, how can its saltiness be restored?
text_cn: 盐原是好的，但如果连盐也失了味道，要用什么来调和它呢？

text_en: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; they throw it away. Let anyone with ears to hear listen! ”
text_cn: 既不利于土壤，又不适于粪料，惟有把它丢在外面。有耳听的，听吧！”
